meta.name: domain-expert
meta.description: Find, evaluate, and recommend domain names. Use when brainstorming domains, checking availability, evaluating names for sound/memorability, or choosing between registrars. Knows Cloudflare, Namecheap, and CrazyDomains TLD coverage.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找并评估可用的域名
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为项目挑一个好记的域名
copy.tagline_en: Find and evaluate available domain names
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a memorable domain for your project

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会帮你搜域名、查是否可注册,并按好不好念、好不好记、有无尴尬谐音等标准评估候选名;还会根据注册商对各个后缀的支持情况给出建议。
howto.when: 当你说要起域名、查某个域名是否可注册、评估名字好不好,或在几个注册商之间做选择时触发。

say.text: 帮我想几个做数据分析工具用的域名,要好念好记的。
say.note: Claude 会按广播测试和发音规则筛选候选名。
会调用查询工具给出确定的是/否。
会对照注册商覆盖表回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps search for domain names, check availability, and evaluate candidates on pronounceability, memorability, and hidden-word risks; it also advises on registrar TLD coverage.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to brainstorm domain names, check availability, evaluate a name's sound or memorability, or choose between registrars.

say_en.text: Suggest memorable, easy-to-say domain names for a data analytics tool.
say_en.note: Claude will filter candidates using the radio test and sound rules.

say_en.text: Check if example.com and example.io are available.
say_en.note: It calls the availability tool for a definite yes/no.
It checks the registrar coverage table.
